about: Living people a liquor shelf fragment never names (style.txt, PEOPLE): the house's own family, the current distillers, blenders, owners and founders of the brands on the shelf, and bartenders and writers a fragment might reach for. schema.mjs refuses any string that carries one of these as a whole phrase, and refuses any run of capitalised words proper-nouns.json does not allow, so this list is the explicit backstop, not the whole rule. Historic founders (George T. Stagg, Thomas H. Handy, Jean Martell, Alexandre Le Grand) are allowed and never listed here. Add a name the moment a source shows one; never remove one.
